message.content: {"count":3,"rationale":"Block vpnSession:authenticate, sshKey:credentialAccess, and mailArchive:collection. Without vpnSession, hypervisor, domainAdmin, and serviceAccount are unreachable, stopping vaultRead and dbReplica. Without sshKey, apiToken is also unreachable; together with blocked vpnSession, this stops printServer and therefore codeRepo. All four target parents are then unreachable. At least three blocks are necessary because there are three reachable derivations with disjoint blockable steps: (1) tokenCache → monitoringHost → mailArchive; (2) sshKey → printServer → codeRepo; (3) browserStore and mailClient → vpnSession → backupHost, with vpnSession and backupHost → serviceAccount → dbReplica. Each derivation requires a separate block."}
